item.title: Ford Philippines Aims To Keep Hybrid SUV Leadership With New Territory Hybrid Platinum. Yours For P 1.655M
item.description: Ford Philippines aims to solidify its lead as the country’s best-selling hybrid SUV with the launch of the new Territory Hybrid Platinum. The new variant sits atop the Titanium X bringing with it an elevated sense of style, added safety, and first-in-class luxury features. Read More »

item.description: Lexus Philippines has introduced the all-new ES with two hybrid variants and the nameplate’s first battery-electric model, giving the executive sedan its broadest powertrain lineup to date. item.title: The tricycle that could swim
item.description: Another week of heavy rain has shown motorists that high ground clearance does not mean a vehicle can safely cross floodwater and an SUV badge is not a life jacket.

item.title: Mitsubishi earns Red Cross honors
item.description: Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corporation (MMPC) has received a Certificate of Recognition from the Philippine Red Cross Laguna Chapter after its blood donation drives collected 404 units in 2025.

item.title: FARE SHOT
item.description: Starting a ride-hailing business usually requires a car before a driver can accept the first booking. That condition alone can place the business out of reach for Filipinos who have the time and willingness to drive but cannot afford a large down payment.
